name: PostKeyMessageToWindow
signature: extern const uint32_t mem_00925618; // IAT slot address of USER32!PostMessageA (unused in portable form) int PostKeyMessageToWindow(void* self, uint32_t msg, uint16_t a2, uint16_t a3)
summary: Posts message 0x100 to this->hwnd with wParam=msg and lParam=(a3<<16)|a2, unless msg is 9 or 13 (then returns msg unchanged).
